Product information "Mapa Butoflex 650 Butyl chemical protective gloves"

The MapaButoflex 650 has an extraordinary wearing comfort. The first butyler with glued in inner knit (650). Without pressing seams. Lace glove for special chemical activities: The Butoflex 650 is highly resistant to highly corrosive acids, ketones, esters and amine derivatives. Unique suppleness and dexterity. Z-pattern profile for optimum grip. Applications: Chemical industry: Manufacture of paints, varnishes, resins and inks, Handling of chemicals, Sampling of chemicals, Cosmetics and pharmaceutical industry: Laboratory work, Mechanical and electronic industry. Standard: EN 388 (1.1.2.2), EN 374 (A.B.C.I.K.L)
 Protection class: Cat. III
 Color: Black
 Material: Butyl
 Length: approx. 35 cm
 Thickness: approx. 1.5 mm
 Characteristics Inner cotton knit, palm with profile
 Packaging unit: 6 pairs
